headline: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña Resigns Amid Banking Crisis
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned following a financial crisis triggered by the collapse of Ueno Bank. The Chamber of Deputies subsequently rejected an impeachment motion against Vice President Pedro Alliana, effectively archiving the case.
why: The collapse of a major digital bank and the subsequent resignation of a head of state represent a significant political and economic shock for Paraguay, potentially impacting investor confidence and regional stability.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Political instability and banking sector failure typically lead to currency depreciation and capital flight.
